text.headline: Timeline of Comoros
text.text: Major events in the history of Comoros.

events.headline: First Settlements
events.text: The first inhabitants of Comoros are believed to have arrived from Southeast Asia and East Africa, establishing early settlements on the islands.

events.headline: Portuguese Exploration
events.text: Portuguese explorers arrived in the Comoros, marking the beginning of European interest in the islands.

events.headline: Omani Influence
events.text: The islands came under the influence of the Omani Empire, which established trade routes and cultural exchanges.

events.headline: French Colonization
events.text: Comoros became a French protectorate, leading to significant changes in governance and society.

events.headline: Overseas Territory
events.text: Comoros was designated as an overseas territory of France, gaining some degree of self-governance.

events.headline: Independence from France
events.text: Comoros declared independence from France, becoming a sovereign nation after a brief struggle.

events.headline: First Coup
events.text: The first coup d'état occurred in Comoros, leading to political instability and a series of subsequent coups.

events.headline: Second Coup
events.text: Another coup took place, further complicating the political landscape of the islands.

events.headline: Civil War
events.text: A civil war broke out in Comoros, fueled by ethnic tensions and political rivalries.

events.headline: Anjouan Secession
events.text: The island of Anjouan declared independence from Comoros, leading to further conflict.

events.headline: Peace Agreement
events.text: A peace agreement was reached, restoring some degree of stability to the islands.

events.headline: New Constitution
events.text: A new constitution was adopted, establishing a federal system of government in Comoros.

events.headline: Presidential Elections
events.text: The first presidential elections under the new constitution were held, marking a step towards democratic governance.

events.headline: Constitutional Referendum
events.text: A referendum was held to amend the constitution, aiming to enhance the powers of the presidency.

events.headline: Political Crisis
events.text: A political crisis erupted following disputed elections, leading to protests and calls for reform.

events.headline: Constitutional Changes
events.text: Further constitutional changes were made, allowing the president to extend their term, which sparked controversy.

events.headline: COVID-19 Pandemic
events.text: The COVID-19 pandemic impacted Comoros, leading to health challenges and economic difficulties.

events.headline: Presidential Elections
events.text: Presidential elections were held amid ongoing political tensions, with calls for fair electoral processes.

events.headline: Current Political Climate
events.text: Comoros continues to navigate its political landscape, facing challenges related to governance, economic development, and social issues.
